1.consolidated_definition: Pez marino de hasta 60 cm de longitud, de cuerpo ovalado, con escamas de varios colores, donde predomina el verde, cabeza pequeña y ojos grandes, con pico córneo, robusto y prominente, parecido al del loro. Scaridae, Sparisoma viride.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Marine fish reaching up to 60 cm in length, with an oval-shaped body, featuring scales of various colors, predominantly green, a small head and large eyes, equipped with a horny, robust, and prominent beak similar to that of a parrot. Family Scaridae, Sparisoma viride.
